title: Summary Sufficiency in Simulation-Based Inference via Mutual Information
abstract: arXiv:2611.21158v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Simulation-based inference (SBI) enables posterior estimation when the likelihood is intractable but data can be simulated from the model. For high-dimensional or variable-length data, SBI methods typically rely on low-dimensional summary statistics as conditioning inputs for posterior estimation, making their sufficiency crucial for accurate inference. Mutual information (MI) provides a natural information-theoretic characterization of sufficiency, quantifying how much parameter information a summary retains. However, these MI quantities are generally intractable in likelihood-free settings. Sui et al. (2026) estimate MI from a trained neural posterior using the Barber--Agakov (BA) lower bound, while discussing, but not computing, a Fisher-information upper bound. This makes the estimate ambiguous: a small lower bound may indicate either an insufficient summary or an inaccurate density estimator. We address this limitation with a trac

translated_title: 基于互信息的仿真推断中摘要统计量充分性研究
translated_abstract: 仿真推断使得在似然函数不可处理但可以从模型中模拟数据的情况下进行后验估计成为可能。对于高维或可变长度的数据，仿真推断方法通常依赖低维摘要统计量作为后验估计的条件输入，这使得摘要统计量的充分性对准确推断至关重要。互信息为充分性提供了一种自然的信息论刻画，用于量化摘要统计量保留了多少参数信息。然而，在无似然设置中，这些互信息量通常是不可计算的。Sui等人（2026）使用Barber–Agakov（BA）下界从训练好的神经后验中估计互信息，同时讨论了但并未计算Fisher信息上界。这使得估计结果存在歧义：较小的下界可能意味着摘要统计量不充分，也可能意味着密度估计器不准确。我们通过一种可处理的（trac……此处摘要截断）方法来解决这一局限。
tldr: 该论文针对仿真推断中摘要统计量充分性的互信息估计歧义问题，提出一种可处理的方法，以区分较小的BA下界究竟源于摘要统计量不充分还是密度估计器不准确。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a tractable approach to disambiguate mutual-information-based assessments of summary sufficiency in simulation-based inference, resolving whether a small lower bound reflects an insufficient summary or an inaccurate density estimator.
